question: Under the same number of HTTP requests per company, do smarter page-selection policies find more facts than production's guessed URL paths?

costModel.unit: one HTTP request, whatever comes back: a page, a 404, a timeout, robots.txt or a sitemap file
costModel.redirects: a redirect chain counts as one request
costModel.readablePage: status below 400, at least 120 characters of readable text, and a final URL not read before in the visit (production's rule)
costModel.robots: a path robots.txt disallows for * was never recorded: no policy asks for it and it costs nothing
costModel.givenUpSites: requests never sent because the site failed 3 times in a row while recording count as failed requests

factTypes.score: how many of the five types production's extractFacts has found so far (0 to 5); a contact email counts on any domain
factTypes.ceiling: the score over every recorded page of the site

today.what: Production's order: the homepage, then its 13 guessed paths in order, stopping once 4 pages were readable.

link-keyword.what: The homepage's own links, best first by a fixed multilingual keyword prior on anchor text and path; no guessed paths.

link-keyword+fallback.what: link-keyword, then production's guessed paths the homepage did not link, once the links run out.

link-keyword@today-spend.what: link-keyword, never allowed more requests on a site than today made there (it makes fewer where the homepage has fewer links): no extra spend, only the choice of pages differs.

learned-links-thompson.what: Links grouped into 10 classes; a Beta posterior per class for 'a page of this class reveals a new fact type', learned online from site to site; Thompson sampling picks the class, the prior picks the link within it.

learned-links-ucb1.what: The same classes and reward, with UCB1 choosing the class.

learned-links-egreedy.what: The same classes and reward, with epsilon-greedy (0.1) choosing the class.

sitemap-first.what: Pays for the sitemap first (/sitemap.xml, else robots.txt and the sitemap it names, plus one child of an index), reads its 6 best URLs by the keyword prior, then goes on with the homepage's links.

random-link.what: The same recorded homepage links in random order: a lower bound for choosing among them.

oracle.what: Knows the facts on every recorded page and takes the page that adds most each time (greedy set cover): an upper bound.

findings: Sample: 180 sites with a readable homepage (no 60, nlde 60, en 60); 5956 requests recorded on them (6694 HTTP exchanges with redirect hops), 33.1 per site on average and at most 45.

The replayed today policy asks for the same URLs in the same order as the real profileFromPages on 180 of 180 sites, and the dossier it returns holds the same fact types on 180 of the 180 sites where production's gate let a dossier through.
today spends 13.3 requests per site on average (median 14, max 14); 83% of them return nothing readable (90% of the guessed paths), and 154 of 180 sites use all 14 without reaching 4 readable pages.
The guessed paths add a fact type to what the homepage already gave on 46 of 180 sites; of the 229 guessed pages today counts as readable, 14 repeat the text of a page it already had.

Guessed paths, readable when asked: /about 43/180, /about-us 13/180, /over-ons 17/180, /ueber-uns 7/175, /unternehmen 1/174, /contact 49/173, /contact-us 2/172, /kontakt 40/172, /impressum 16/170, /careers 23/168, /jobs 4/160, /vacatures 7/158, /karriere 7/155.

At 4 requests per site, today finds 1.89 of 5 fact types on average and link-keyword 2.51 (+0.62, 95% interval +0.51 to +0.73, paired over 180 sites; better on 47% of sites, equal on 51%, worse on 2%); random links find 2.37 and the oracle 3.04.
The highest mean at 4 requests is learned-links-egreedy with 2.55 (+0.66 [+0.56, +0.76] against today); against link-keyword that is +0.04 [−0.02, +0.11].

At 4 requests, a contact email is found on 41% of sites by today and 74% by link-keyword (+0.33, interval +0.27 to +0.40); an email on the site's own domain on 36% against 66% (+0.30, interval +0.23 to +0.37); a self-description on 90% against 98%.
At 4 requests, requests that return nothing readable: today 65%, link-keyword 1%, sitemap-first 8% plus 34% spent on robots.txt and sitemap files.
By group at 4 requests, link-keyword against today: no +0.82 [+0.58, +1.07]; nlde +0.53 [+0.37, +0.72]; en +0.50 [+0.32, +0.70].

At 8 requests per site, today finds 1.97 of 5 fact types on average and link-keyword 2.73 (+0.76, 95% interval +0.63 to +0.89, paired over 180 sites; better on 55% of sites, equal on 44%, worse on 1%); random links find 2.63 and the oracle 3.04.
The highest mean at 8 requests is learned-links-thompson with 2.76 (+0.79 [+0.66, +0.91] against today); against link-keyword that is +0.02 [−0.03, +0.07].

At 8 requests, a contact email is found on 46% of sites by today and 81% by link-keyword (+0.34, interval +0.27 to +0.41); an email on the site's own domain on 40% against 71% (+0.31, interval +0.24 to +0.37); a self-description on 91% against 98%.
At 8 requests, requests that return nothing readable: today 78%, link-keyword 1%, sitemap-first 5% plus 18% spent on robots.txt and sitemap files.
By group at 8 requests, link-keyword against today: no +0.92 [+0.68, +1.17]; nlde +0.57 [+0.40, +0.75]; en +0.80 [+0.58, +1.03].

Never allowed more requests on a site than today makes there (today 13.3 per site on average; link-keyword runs out of links sooner on some sites and uses 10.3), link-keyword finds 2.84 fact types against today's 2.12 (+0.73 [+0.61, +0.85]).
On the 115 sites where every homepage link was recorded, link-keyword against today is +0.67 [+0.52, +0.81] at 4 requests and +0.77 [+0.61, +0.94] at 8.
Against everything today finds with up to 14 requests (2.12 fact types), link-keyword is +0.07 [−0.02, +0.14] with 2 requests and +0.39 [+0.30, +0.50] with 4.

To reach the score today ends with, today itself needs 2.7 requests on average and link-keyword 1.5 (a miss within 14 requests counts as 15; link-keyword gets there on 99% of sites). At 4 requests link-keyword already equals or beats today's final score on 97% of sites.

Learning across sites (Thompson sampling, 40 site orders) at 2 requests: 2.23 on average, +0.05 [−0.01, +0.11] against link-keyword over all sites; +0.01 on the first third of sites visited and +0.08 on the last third (change +0.07 [+0.04, +0.11], interval over site orders).

Learning across sites (Thompson sampling, 40 site orders) at 4 requests: 2.55 on average, +0.04 [−0.03, +0.10] against link-keyword over all sites; +0.01 on the first third of sites visited and +0.06 on the last third (change +0.05 [+0.02, +0.08], interval over site orders).

Learning across sites (Thompson sampling, 40 site orders) at 8 requests: 2.76 on average, +0.02 [−0.03, +0.07] against link-keyword over all sites; +0.02 on the first third of sites visited and +0.02 on the last third (change −0.00 [−0.02, +0.02], interval over site orders).

Thompson's posterior mean per link class after a pass at 4 requests (chance that a page of the class reveals a new fact type): legal 0.32, contact 0.24, about 0.23, team 0.20, quality 0.20, careers 0.15, other 0.15, products 0.12, news 0.11, shop 0.09.

Share of recorded links whose page holds a fact type the homepage lacks, by class: legal 49% (271 links), contact 33% (164 links), team 29% (28 links), quality 25% (88 links), about 25% (219 links), careers 22% (85 links), news 19% (252 links), other 13% (827 links), products 12% (771 links), shop 10% (77 links).

A usable sitemap was found on 152 of 180 sites (/sitemap.xml itself answered with a sitemap on 152); sitemap-first pays 1.7 requests on average before its first page, finds 2.24 at 4 requests and 2.91 at 14.
The homepage alone gives 1.84 of 5 fact types on average and all recorded pages together 3.04; on 53 of 180 sites no recorded page adds anything to the homepage.

Limits: 65 of 180 homepages had more same-site links than were recorded (the 25 best by the keyword prior were); 1 site was given up on while recording; robots.txt removed 2 guessed path(s) on 1 site(s) and 87 homepage links; production's 40 s time budget would have cut today short on 1 site(s) at the recorded response times; candidates whose homepage could not be read are not in the sample (no: 6 of 66 tried, nlde: 17 of 77 tried, en: 3 of 63 tried).
